registrationDeadline: strictly before developmentStart; no retrospective registration

opening.reset: each development fold and holdout; no transfer of profitable state

priorTrials: The separate 2026-09-26 execution-policy-v1 registration declared eight variants. Its incomplete evidence remains separate. Wider universe, hourly, selector, range, breakout and ML registrations remain distinct trials; no history is erased.

A.dailySizing: completed close, broker-equivalent simulated equity and market values

C.pendingChanges: persist until directionally within change threshold or superseded

passive-equal-weight.openingAllocation: one third each BTC ETH LTC

costs.fills: immediate market model; never actual Alpaca evidence

coverage: Every slot, all seven arms at both costs, common venue rules and quotes, completed-day target, common opening, and boundary terminal frame required. A gap invalidates the fold. No imputation, favorable truncation, date extension, or historical backfill of prospective frames.
primaryMetric: net-return lift of B C D versus A at matched capital, common frames and common cost scenario
drawdownRequirement: no worse maximum drawdown than A in every development fold at base and doubled costs, and in the untouched holdout
secondaryMetrics: missed-opportunity value unavailable without a separately observed counterfactual
selection: All development folds complete; positive net lift and no worse drawdown in each fold at both costs; positive simultaneous lower uncertainty bound at both costs. Rank surviving B C D by sum of base-cost fold lifts, ties by candidate ID. No survivor means retain A. Freeze signed winner/none plus report and rule hash before any holdout result is opened. Collect holdout books without inspecting performance; the development terminal boundary quote may be read only as the preceding fold's terminal mark.

uncertainty.method: paired circular block bootstrap of candidate minus A matched daily returns
uncertainty.family: Bonferroni simultaneous 95 percent across B C D, each cost scenario must pass
uncertainty.limitations: Engineering choice, not validated statistical power. Report insufficient evidence if bounds are too wide or dependence exceeds the block model. No calendar duration guarantees power.

temporalLeakage: Signals use only previous completed daily bars. Frame evidence is observed within its slot; marks cannot be substituted retrospectively. No overlapping predictive labels in this execution-only comparison. Any future labeled model must register purge/embargo based on its label interval; no random time-series split.
holdoutOpening: Explicit separate owner review after 2027-03-14, frozen selection verified first, complete coverage required. The implementation exposes only a development report and does not open the holdout.
promotion: Never automatic. A favorable model result requires independent prospective/connected execution evidence and a separate reviewed operational change.
unregisteredVariantRule: Document hypothesis and immutable trial identity before evaluating an additional alternative; no unrestricted sweep. Functional tests are not investment trials.
identityBinding: At explicit registration bind profile, experiment, five definition versions, dates, opening convention, current tested behavior manifest and full diagnostic artifact hash into StudyInstance. This proposal has no owner profile, experiment or registered instance.
